message.content:
A magazine cover illustration features two people leaning against closed double doors. On the left, a woman wearing a white hijab and tunic leans back with her eyes open and mouth slightly agape. Beside her, a man in a light-colored button-down shirt and dark pants stands with arms crossed, smiling. Behind them, multiple disembodied hands and arms emerge from the sides of the doors. One hand holds a white megaphone, another a clenched fist, and others reach outward. A black sneaker floats in the air above.

The background is a warm orange and red. In the foreground, a yellow hard hat sits on a black-and-white checkered floor. Small metal screws and a rectangular wooden plank float in the air. Wisps of white smoke or clouds appear on the left and right sides. Large red letters "TEMPO" span the top. White text reads "BADAI PHK DI DEPAN MATA" and "Buntut gejolak ekonomi global, satu juta pekerja industri padat karya terancam dipecat. Benarkah ada upaya untuk menutup-nutupi? H.70". A barcode and QR code are in the upper right.
